values.note: $35 a night, paid at the paystation in front of the campground office (exact cash or card) by 10 a.m. or within an hour of arrival. Dump station $15.

fees.source: https://bouldercounty.gov/open-space/fairgrounds/campground/ ('Camping fee: $35 per night', 'Dump station fee: $15', payment rules; page (c) 2026), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 36 sites have 30 or 50 A electric and water, 8 have 30 A electric and water, 27 have 30 A electric only. No sewer hookups: grey and black water go to the dump station.

hookups.source: Campground site map linked from the county page (legend: '30 AMP Electric Only', '30 AMP Electric & Water', '30 or 50 AMP Electric & Water'; no sewer category) + https://bouldercounty.gov/open-space/fairgrounds/campground/ ('Grey and black water must be dumped at the dump station'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 71 numbered sites on the county's map: 1-8 and 24-51 (30/50 A + water), 16-23 (30 A + water), 9-15 and 52-71 (30 A electric only). RVs and campers only; tent and car camping prohibited.

sites.source: Campground site map (sites 1-71 by hookup class) + https://bouldercounty.gov/open-space/fairgrounds/campground/ ('Tent and car camping is prohibited'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Restrooms and showers open to paid campers March through October; water available seasonally.

facilities.source: https://bouldercounty.gov/open-space/fairgrounds/campground/ ('Restroom and shower facilities are open to all paid campers from March through October', 'Water is available seasonally', 'Dump station fee: $15'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://bouldercounty.gov/open-space/fairgrounds/campground/ ('This convenient, in-town campground provides year-round RV and camper facilities for visitors to fairground events, Boulder County, or just passing through'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: No reservations; first come, first served. The 14-day limit is per guest per calendar year. Checkout 10 a.m.

booking.source: https://bouldercounty.gov/open-space/fairgrounds/campground/ ('The campground does not accept reservations. Sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'All guests are limited to a maximum stay of 14 days within a calendar year'; 'Checkout time is 10 a.m.'), read 2026-10-27

note: Boulder County's in-town fairgrounds campground in Longmont (9595 Nelson Rd), open to anyone passing through, not only fairground-event visitors; pay at the paystation by the campground office. The county's only open-space property that allows camping. --Claude
summary: County page + its 2025 site map: $35/night (dump $15), FCFS only, year-round, 14 days per calendar year, showers Mar-Oct, 71 sites (36 at 30/50 A + water, 8 at 30 A + water, 27 at 30 A electric only). Added electric 50, 71 sites, potable water; changed sewer true -> false (no sewer class on the map; grey/black water to the dump station). Confirmed the rest. Note trimmed.
flags: Sewer: the note's '16 RV sites with full water/electric/sewer hookups' is contradicted by the county's current site map (no sewer category) and rule 'Grey and black water must be dumped at the dump station'; sewer written false (derived value).
